mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", entity_id AS "entityId", display_name AS "displayName", description AS description, image_uri AS "imageUri", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.game_entities WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY entity_id

SELECT game_id AS "gameId", entity_id AS "entityId", display_name AS "displayName", description AS description, image_uri AS "imageUri", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.game_entities WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND entity_id = #{entityId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.game_entities (game_id, entity_id, display_name, description, image_uri, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{entityId}, #{displayName}, #{description}, #{imageUri}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, entity_id) DO UPDATE SET display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, description = EXCLUDED.description, image_uri = EXCLUDED.image_uri, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", entity_id AS "entityId", display_name AS "displayName", description AS description, image_uri AS "imageUri", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.game_entities WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, entity_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.game_entities_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, entity_id, display_name, description, image_uri ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, entity_id, display_name, description, image_uri FROM public.game_entities WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, entity_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, description = EXCLUDED.description, image_uri = EXCLUDED.image_uri
